title: Smoky Brazilian Skewer Vegetarian Delight
description: A delicious and healthy vegetarian skewer dish infused with the flavors of Brazil, featuring smoky roasted vegetables. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Smoky Sausage-Free Skewers (Portobello Mushrooms)
ingredients.notes: Marinated in a mixture of olive oil, lime juice, and Brazilian spices

ingredients.name: Brazilian-Style Corn On The Cob
ingredients.notes: Grilled and slathered with a mixture of mayonnaise, chopped cilantro, and lime juice

ingredients.name: Brazilian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: A mixture of cumin, coriander, and chili powder

instructions: Thread the marinated portobello mushrooms, bell peppers, onions, zucchini, cherry tomatoes, and Brazilian-style corn onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with smoked paprika, Brazilian spice blend, and salt.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes per side, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
For the Brazilian-style corn, grill the ears of corn for 5-7 minutes per side, or until lightly charred.
Slather each ear with a mixture of mayonnaise, chopped cilantro, and lime juice.
